Select a question above or ask something else Czech-based online travel agency Kiwi, known for its creative approach to offering flight deals, informed staff Thursday that it was conducting a round of layoffs. Some 250 employees were impacted, a spokesperson said. Kiwi CEO Oliver Dlouhy announced the layoffs internally and wrote about them on LinkedIn Thursday. He said Kiwi will continue to focus on providing low fares and keeping customers satisfied. "Delivering both, at scale and over time, requires clear priorities, fast execution, and a structure designed to support the next phase of Kiwi.com," Dlouhy wrote.
